reason: I’ll fill the methane tank first; both separate tanks need propellant, and either order appears possible.
expectation: I expect the plant to transfer liquid methane into the ascent tank while keeping the oxygen circuit separate.

alternatives.reason: The oxygen tank also needs filling, but there is no apparent reason to prefer it first.

effect: The methane tank is filled, leaving the oxygen tank to complete the stated goal.
reaction: The rising level indicator makes the transfer feel tangible.
reason: The oxygen tank is the remaining goal, and this is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the plant to transfer liquid oxygen through its separate line into the ascent oxygen tank.

effect: The separate oxygen tank is filled, completing the chapter’s goal.
reaction: The oxygen-clean line and separate tanks made the transfer feel physically sensible, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the methane tank was the most tangible moment: the rising indicator connected the long production effort to the spacecraft.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the oxygen tank was straightforward but repetitive after the methane transfer.

surprise.text: Nothing in this short chapter particularly surprised me; both transfers worked as expected.

arbitrary.text: Neither transfer felt arbitrary, although the order was a free choice with no apparent consequence.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the return and the discovery resolve, although this chapter’s two predictable transfers were not compelling on their own.
